process_dies_before_db_commit.required_outcome: uncommitted money effect is absent and durable work remains reclaimable

process_dies_after_db_commit.required_outcome: redelivery observes terminal durable truth and creates no second effect

process_dies_before_provider_call.required_outcome: provider attempt is fenced durably before external I/O

provider_succeeds_then_process_dies.required_outcome: successful provider evidence is retained for reconciliation and never blindly retried

provider_times_out.required_outcome: ambiguous outcome becomes reconciliation-required rather than duplicate provider mutation

provider_returns_malformed_response.required_outcome: malformed or authority-mismatched response cannot finalize money

webhook_arrives_before_checkout_response.required_outcome: signed evidence is queued as retryable until provider order binding commits

duplicate_webhook.required_outcome: one inbox event and one payment event

100_concurrent_callbacks.required_outcome: one claim winner and one financial application

payment_and_cancellation_race.required_outcome: Finance cannot override cancellation or directly grant entitlement

payment_and_renewal_race.required_outcome: Finance emits durable facts only; renewal remains product-domain authority

payment_and_expiry_race.required_outcome: payment confirmation cannot bypass expiry state authority

settlement_and_refund_race.required_outcome: both operations serialize on payment truth with one settlement effect and one bounded refund obligation

db_deadlock.required_outcome: deadlock victim is explicit and retryable; no split authoritative state

db_restart.required_outcome: durable work survives PostgreSQL loss and resumes after recovery

network_partition.required_outcome: external ambiguity is durable and recoverable

redis_loss.required_outcome: database monetary truth survives broker loss and processing resumes

celery_redelivery.required_outcome: late acknowledgement/redelivery converges to one logical effect

worker_sigkill.required_outcome: real prefork child SIGKILL cannot lose or duplicate durable work

lease_expiry.required_outcome: expired lease is reclaimed with a higher fence and stale completion cannot win

clock_skew.required_outcome: money-worker leases use PostgreSQL clock_timestamp rather than caller clocks

provider_clock_skew.required_outcome: future provider timestamps beyond the bounded skew window are rejected
